implementation.limits: Maximum subdivision depth32; explicit max_vertices and caller-supplied device-space tolerance. Nonfinite input and invalid settings refused; cancellation checked at operators and subdivision nodes.

verification.independent_accuracy: Own cubic area alpha63 preserved in full512x384 and translated64x64 tile at0.0001 pixel tolerance.
